title: LLM role
description: One LLM call the pack configures: the prompt it uses, the model, and its generation parameters. 'role' is a name the pack chooses (e.g. 'assistant', 'generator', 'judge', 'schedule'); the harness holds no role enum (ADR-0002, ADR-0018) and does not interpret it. Tuning values (model, temperature, max_tokens) live entirely in the pack (ADR-0002); the harness adds no defaults. 'prompt' names a pack-internal Markdown file whose existence the Importer checks; role names must be unique across a pack's llm_roles files (checked by the Importer, not this schema).

role.description: Pack-chosen name for this LLM call. Not an enum.

model.description: Model identifier passed to the provider adapter, e.g. 'gpt-5.4-2026-03-05'.

prompt.description: Path, relative to the pack root, of the Markdown prompt file for this role.

output_schema.description: $id of the contracts schema this role's structured output must validate against, when the role has one yet.
